spacelift_ai_integration.description:
`spacelift_ai_integration` represents an integration with an AI/LLM provider, used by Spacelift features that call out to a model.

The provider is chosen by setting exactly one provider block: `anthropic`, `bedrock`, `google` (the Gemini API) or `openai`. Changing which block is set replaces the integration, because the API does not allow an existing one to change provider.

A fifth block, `spacelift`, marks an integration that Spacelift provides and shares with every account. Those can only be imported and toggled, so the block takes no arguments and everything except `enabled` has to be left out of the configuration.

ai_provider.description: AI provider backing the integration, derived from the provider block that is set

enabled.description: Whether the integration can be used for LLM calls. Defaults to `true`.

is_spacelift_provided.description: Whether this is a read-only, Spacelift-managed integration shared with every account

labels.description: Labels to set on the integration

models.description: Model identifiers this integration is pinned to, for example `gemini-2.5-pro`. Leave it out, or set it to an empty list, to pin nothing and let the integration follow the default model list for its provider, which is resolved server side and not recorded here. Terraform owns the pin either way, so one made outside it is reverted on the next apply, the same as `labels`. Not supported for Bedrock, which takes its models from `bedrock.profiles` instead.

name.description: Friendly name of the integration. Required, except on a Spacelift-provided integration, whose name belongs to Spacelift and is read back from the API.

space_id.description: ID of the space the integration belongs to

api_key_wo_version.description: Used together with api_key_wo to trigger an update to the API key. Increment this value when an update to api_key_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

base_url.description: Custom base URL for a self-hosted, Anthropic-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM. Leave unset to call the provider directly.

profiles.description: Bedrock inference profile ARNs to expose. Spacelift validates these against AWS through the attached integration when the integration is saved.

region.description: AWS region the Bedrock requests are routed through, for example `us-east-1`

api_key_wo.description: Gemini API key. The key is not stored in the state. Modify api_key_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

api_key_wo_version.description: Used together with api_key_wo to trigger an update to the API key. Increment this value when an update to api_key_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

base_url.description: Custom base URL for a self-hosted, Gemini-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM. Leave unset to call the provider directly.

base_url.description: Custom base URL for a self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible gateway such as LiteLLM. Leave unset to call the provider directly.

block.description: Marks a read-only integration provided by Spacelift and shared with every account. The block takes no arguments because everything except `enabled` belongs to Spacelift. These integrations cannot be created or deleted, so the resource has to be imported, and removing it from the configuration only drops it from the state.

spacelift_api_key.description:
`spacelift_api_key` represents a Spacelift API Key - a credential that can be used to authenticate with the Spacelift API from outside of Spacelift, typically for automation purposes.

### WARNING

**This resource manages API keys which are sensitive credentials. These keys will be saved to your state file. Ensure that you handle your state file securely.**

idp_groups.description: List of idp groups associated with the API key

secret.description: The secret value of the API key

type.description: Type of the API key (SECRET or OIDC)

block.description: OIDC configuration for the API key. When provided, creates an OIDC API key instead of a SECRET API key.

claim_mappings.description: Mapping of IdP JWT claim names to Spacelift claim names. Currently only the `groups` Spacelift claim is supported, so the value should always be `groups` (e.g. `teams = "groups"` maps the IdP `teams` claim to Spacelift `groups`). When configured, the mapped claims are extracted from the OIDC token at authentication time, enabling dynamic team membership based on the authenticating user's actual IdP groups.

spacelift_audit_trail_webhook.description: `spacelift_audit_trail_webhook` represents a webhook endpoint to which Spacelift sends POST requests about audit events.

custom_headers.description: `custom_headers` is a Map of key-value strings, that will be passed as headers with audit trail requests.

enabled.description: `enabled` determines whether the webhook is enabled. If it is not, Spacelift will not send any requests to the endpoint.

endpoint.description: `endpoint` is the URL to which Spacelift will send POST requests about audit events.

include_runs.description: `include_runs` determines whether the webhook should include information about the run that triggered the event.

retry_on_failure.description: whether to retry the webhook in case of failure. Defaults to `false`.

secret.description: `secret` is a secret that Spacelift will send with the request. Note that once it's created, it will be just an empty string in the state due to security reasons.

secret_wo.description: `secret_wo` is a secret that Spacelift will send with the request. The secret_wo is not stored in the state. Modify secret_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

secret_wo_version.description: Used together with secret_wo to trigger an update to the secret. Increment this value when an update to secret_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

spacelift_aws_integration.description:
`spacelift_aws_integration` represents an integration with an AWS account. This integration is account-level and needs to be explicitly attached to individual stacks in order to take effect.

Note: when assuming credentials for **shared workers**, Spacelift will use `$accountName@$integrationID@$stackID@$suffix` or `$accountName@$integrationID@$moduleID@$suffix` as [external ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_create_for-user_externalid.html) and `$runID@$stackID@$accountName` truncated to 64 characters as [session ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRole),$suffix will be `read` or `write`.

autoattach_enabled.description: Enables `autoattach:` labels functionality for this integration.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds for which the assumed role credentials should be valid. Defaults to `900`.

external_id.description: Custom external ID (works only for private workers).

generate_credentials_in_worker.description: Generate AWS credentials in the private worker. Defaults to `false`.

labels.description: Labels to set on the integration

name.description: The friendly name of the integration

region.description: AWS region to select a regional AWS STS endpoint.

role_arn.description: ARN of the AWS IAM role to attach

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the integration is in

tag_assume_role.description: When enabled, Spacelift will tag the assume role action with run and stack metadata. Defaults to `false`.

spacelift_aws_integration_attachment.description: `spacelift_aws_integration_attachment` represents the attachment between a reusable AWS integration and a single stack or module.

attachment_id.description: Internal ID of the attachment entity

integration_id.description: ID of the integration to attach

module_id.description: ID of the module to attach the integration to

read.description: Indicates whether this attachment is used for read operations. Defaults to `true`.

stack_id.description: ID of the stack to attach the integration to

write.description: Indicates whether this attachment is used for write operations. Defaults to `true`.

spacelift_aws_role.description:
**NOTE:** while this resource continues to work, we have replaced it with the `spacelift_aws_integration` resource. The new resource allows integrations to be shared by multiple stacks/modules and also supports separate read vs write roles. Please use the `spacelift_aws_integration` resource instead.

`spacelift_aws_role` represents [cross-account IAM role delegation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html) between the Spacelift worker and an individual stack or module. If this is set, Spacelift will use AWS STS to assume the supplied IAM role and put its temporary credentials in the runtime environment.

If you use private workers, you can also assume IAM role on the worker side using your own AWS credentials (e.g. from EC2 instance profile).

Note: when assuming credentials for **shared worker**, Spacelift will use `$accountName@$stackID` or `$accountName@$moduleID` as [external ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_create_for-user_externalid.html) and `$runID@$stackID@$accountName` truncated to 64 characters as [session ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRole).

duration_seconds.description: AWS IAM role session duration in seconds

external_id.description: Custom external ID (works only for private workers).

generate_credentials_in_worker.description: Generate AWS credentials in the private worker. Defaults to `false`.

module_id.description: ID of the module which assumes the AWS IAM role

region.description: AWS region to select a regional AWS STS endpoint.

role_arn.description: ARN of the AWS IAM role to attach

stack_id.description: ID of the stack which assumes the AWS IAM role

spacelift_azure_devops_integration.description: `spacelift_azure_devops_integration` represents an integration with an Azure DevOps organization

accessible_projects.description: Restrict the integration to specific Azure DevOps projects. Leave empty to allow all projects in the organization.

id.description: Azure DevOps integration id.

is_default.description: Is the Azure DevOps integration the default for all spaces? If set to `true` the space must be set to `root` in `space_id` or left empty which uses the default

labels.description: Labels to set on the integration

name.description: The friendly name of the integration

organization_url.description: Organization URL where API requests will be sent

personal_access_token.description: The Azure DevOps personal access token

personal_access_token_wo.description: `personal_access_token_wo` the Azure DevOps personal access token. The personal_access_token_wo is not stored in the state. Modify personal_access_token_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

personal_access_token_wo_version.description: Used together with personal_access_token_wo to trigger an update to the personal access token. Increment this value when an update to personal_access_token_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the integration is in; Default: `root`

use_git_checkout.description: Indicates whether the integration should use git checkout. If false source code will be downloaded using the VCS API. Defaults to true.

user_facing_host.description: User facing host URL. Defaults to the organization URL if not set. Set this when using VCS agents.

vcs_checks.description: VCS checks configured for Azure DevOps repositories. Possible values: INDIVIDUAL, AGGREGATED, ALL. Defaults to INDIVIDUAL.

webhook_password.description: Password for webhooks originating from Azure DevOps repositories

webhook_url.description: URL for webhooks originating from Azure DevOps repositories

spacelift_azure_integration.description: `spacelift_azure_integration` represents an integration with an Azure AD tenant. This integration is account-level and needs to be explicitly attached to individual stacks in order to take effect. Note that you will need to provide admin consent manually for the integration to work

admin_consent_provided.description: Indicates whether admin consent has been performed for the AAD Application.

admin_consent_url.description: The URL to use to provide admin consent to the application in the customer's tenant

application_id.description: The applicationId of the Azure AD application used by the integration.

autoattach_enabled.description: Enables `autoattach:` labels functionality for this integration.

default_subscription_id.description: The default subscription ID to use, if one isn't specified at the stack/module level

display_name.description: The display name for the application in Azure. This is automatically generated when the integration is created, and cannot be changed without deleting and recreating the integration.

labels.description: Labels to set on the integration

name.description: The friendly name of the integration

object_id.description: The objectId of the Azure AD application used by the integration.

service_principal_object_id.description: This is the unique ID of the service principal object associated with this application. This ID can be useful when performing management operations against this application using programmatic interfaces.

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the integration is in

spacelift_azure_integration_attachment.description: `spacelift_azure_integration_attachment` represents the attachment between a reusable Azure integration and a single stack or module.

attachment_id.description: Internal ID of the attachment entity

integration_id.description: ID of the integration to attach

module_id.description: ID of the module to attach the integration to

read.description: Indicates whether this attachment is used for read operations. Defaults to `true`.

stack_id.description: ID of the stack to attach the integration to

subscription_id.description: Contains the Azure subscription ID to use with this Stack.  Overrides the default subscription ID set at the integration level.

write.description: Indicates whether this attachment is used for write operations. Defaults to `true`.

spacelift_bitbucket_datacenter_integrati.description: `spacelift_bitbucket_datacenter_integration` represents details of a bitbucket datacenter integration

access_token_wo.description: `access_token_wo` user acces token from Bitbucket. The access_token_wo is not stored in the state. Modify access_token_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

access_token_wo_version.description: Used together with access_token_wo to trigger an update to the access token. Increment this value when an update to access_token_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

api_host.description: The API host where requests will be sent

id.description: Bitbucket Datacenter integration id.

space_id.description: Bitbucket Datacenter integration space id. Defaults to `root`.

use_git_checkout.description: Indicates whether the integration should use git checkout. If false source code will be downloaded using the VCS API. Defaults to false.

user_facing_host.description: User Facing Host which will be used for all user-facing URLs displayed in the Spacelift UI

username.description: Username which will be used to authenticate requests for cloning repositories

vcs_checks.description: VCS checks configured for Bitbucket Datacenter repositories. Possible values: INDIVIDUAL, AGGREGATED, ALL. Defaults to INDIVIDUAL.

webhook_secret.description: Secret for webhooks originating from Bitbucket repositories

webhook_url.description: URL for webhooks originating from Bitbucket repositories

spacelift_blueprint.description: `spacelift_blueprint` represents a Spacelift blueprint, which allows you to easily create stacks using a templating engine. For Terraform users it's preferable to use `spacelift_stack` instead. This resource is mostly useful for those who do not use Terraform to create stacks.

space.description: ID of the space the blueprint is in

state.description: State of the blueprint. Value can be `DRAFT` or `PUBLISHED`.

template.description: Body of the blueprint. If `state` is set to `PUBLISHED`, this field is required.

spacelift_context.description: `spacelift_context` represents a Spacelift **context** - a collection of configuration elements (either environment variables or mounted files) that can be administratively attached to multiple stacks (`spacelift_stack`) or modules (`spacelift_module`) using a context attachment (`spacelift_context_attachment`)`

labels.description: The labels of the context. To leverage the `autoattach` magic label, ensure your label follows the naming convention: `autoattach:<your-label-name>`

name.description: Name of the context - should be unique in one account

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the context is in

spacelift_context_attachment.description: `spacelift_context_attachment` represents a Spacelift attachment of a single context to a single stack or module, with a predefined priority.

context_id.description: ID of the context to attach

module_id.description: ID of the module to attach the context to

priority.description: Priority of the context attachment. All the contexts attached to a stack are sorted by priority (lowest first), though values don't need to be unique. This ordering establishes precedence rules between contexts should there be a conflict and multiple contexts define the same value. Defaults to `0`.

stack_id.description: ID of the stack to attach the context to

spacelift_default_runner_image.description: `spacelift_default_runner_image` represents the default runner images that will be used for public and private worker pools.

private.description: Runner image to be used for private worker pools

public.description: Runner image to be used for public worker pools

spacelift_drift_detection.description: `spacelift_drift_detection` represents a Drift Detection configuration for a Stack. It will trigger a proposed run on the given schedule, which you can listen for using run state webhooks. If reconcile is true, then a tracked run will be triggered when drift is detected.

ignore_state.description: Controls whether drift detection should be performed on a stack in any final state instead of just 'Finished'.

reconcile.description: Whether a tracked run should be triggered when drift is detected.

schedule.description: List of cron schedule expressions based on which drift detection should be triggered.

stack_id.description: ID of the stack for which to set up drift detection

timezone.description: Timezone in which the schedule is expressed. Defaults to `UTC`.

spacelift_environment_variable.description:
`spacelift_environment_variable` defines an environment variable on the context (`spacelift_context`), stack (`spacelift_stack`) or a module (`spacelift_module`), thereby allowing to pass and share various secrets and configuration with Spacelift stacks.

For secret variables (`write_only`), prefer using `value_wo` and `value_wo_version` instead of `value`. `value_wo` is a write-only attribute that never gets stored in state. Note that the checksum will still be present in state for drift detection.

context_id.description: ID of the context on which the environment variable is defined

module_id.description: ID of the module on which the environment variable is defined

stack_id.description: ID of the stack on which the environment variable is defined

value.description: Value of the environment variable. Defaults to an empty string.

value_wo.description: Value of the environment variable. The value is not stored in the state. Modify value_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

value_wo_version.description: Used together with value_wo to trigger an update to the value of the environment variable. Increment this value when an update to value_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

write_only.description: Indicates whether the value is secret or not. Defaults to `true`.

spacelift_gcp_service_account.description: `spacelift_gcp_service_account` represents a Google Cloud Platform service account that's linked to a particular Stack or Module. These accounts are created by Spacelift on per-stack basis, and can be added as members to as many organizations and projects as needed. During a Run or a Task, temporary credentials for those service accounts are injected into the environment, which allows credential-less GCP Terraform provider setup.

module_id.description: ID of the module which uses GCP service account credentials

service_account_email.description: Email address of the GCP service account dedicated for this stack

stack_id.description: ID of the stack which uses GCP service account credentials

token_scopes.description: List of scopes that will be requested when generating temporary GCP service account credentials

spacelift_gitlab_integration.description: `spacelift_gitlab_integration` represents an integration with a GitLab instance

id.description: GitLab integration id.

is_default.description: Is the GitLab integration the default for all spaces? If set to `true` the space must be set to `root` in `space_id` or left empty which uses the default

labels.description: Labels to set on the integration

name.description: The friendly name of the integration

private_token_wo.description: `private_token_wo` the GitLab API Token .The private_token_wo is not stored in the state. Modify private_token_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

private_token_wo_version.description: Used together with private_token_wo to trigger an update to the private_token. Increment this value when an update to private_token_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the integration is in; Default: `root`

use_git_checkout.description: Indicates whether the integration should use git checkout. If false source code will be downloaded using the VCS API. Defaults to true.

vcs_checks.description: VCS checks configured for GitLab repositories. Possible values: INDIVIDUAL, AGGREGATED, ALL. Defaults to INDIVIDUAL.

webhook_secret.description: Secret for webhooks originating from GitLab repositories

webhook_url.description: URL for webhooks originating from GitLab repositories

spacelift_idp_group_mapping.description:
`spacelift_idp_group_mapping` represents a mapping between a group in an IdP and Spacelift.
Note: The `policy` attribute, previously used to assign roles to the group, is deprecated. Use the `spacelift_role_attachment` resource to manage group roles instead.

description.description: Description of the IdP group mapping

name.description: Name of the IdP group as defined in the SSO provider - should be unique per account

block.description: List of access rules for the IdP group.

role.description: Type of access to the space. Possible values are: READ, WRITE, ADMIN

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the IdP group mapping has access to

spacelift_module.description: `spacelift_module` is a special type of a stack used to test and version Terraform modules.

administrative.description: Indicates whether this module can manage others. Defaults to `false`.

aws_assume_role_policy_statement.description: AWS IAM assume role policy statement setting up trust relationship

branch.description: GitHub branch to apply changes to

enable_local_preview.description: Indicates whether local preview versions can be triggered on this Module. Defaults to `false`.

git_sparse_checkout_paths.description: Git sparse checkout paths is an optional list of paths to use for sparse checkout. If not set, the entire repository will be checked out.

name.description: The module name will by default be inferred from the repository name if it follows the terraform-provider-name naming convention. However, if the repository doesn't follow this convention, or you want to give it a custom name, you can provide it here.

project_root.description: Project root is the optional directory relative to the repository root containing the module source code.

protect_from_deletion.description: Protect this module from accidental deletion. If set, attempts to delete this module will fail. Defaults to `false`.

public.description: Make this module publicly accessible. Can only be set at creation time. Defaults to `false`.

repository.description: Name of the repository, without the owner part

runner_image.description: Name of the Docker image used to process Runs

shared_accounts.description: List of the accounts (subdomains) which should have access to the Module

space_id.description: ID (slug) of the space the module is in

space_shares.description: List of the space IDs which should have access to the Module

terraform_provider.description: The module provider will by default be inferred from the repository name if it follows the terraform-provider-name naming convention. However, if the repository doesn't follow this convention, or you gave the module a custom name, you can provide the provider name here.

worker_pool_id.description: ID of the worker pool to use. NOTE: worker_pool_id is required when using a self-hosted instance of Spacelift.

workflow_tool.description: Defines the tool that will be used to execute the workflow. This can be one of `OPEN_TOFU`, `TERRAFORM_FOSS` or `CUSTOM`. Defaults to `TERRAFORM_FOSS`.

block.description: Azure DevOps VCS settings

is_default.description: Indicates whether this is the default Azure DevOps integration

project.description: The name of the Azure DevOps project

block.description: Bitbucket Cloud VCS settings

id.description: The ID of the Bitbucket Cloud integration. If not specified, the default integration will be used.

is_default.description: Indicates whether this is the default Bitbucket Cloud integration

namespace.description: The Bitbucket project containing the repository

block.description: Bitbucket Datacenter VCS settings

id.description: The ID of the Bitbucket Datacenter integration. If not specified, the default integration will be used.

is_default.description: Indicates whether this is the default Bitbucket Datacenter integration

namespace.description: The Bitbucket project containing the repository

block.description: GitHub Enterprise (self-hosted) VCS settings

id.description: The ID of the GitHub Enterprise integration. If not specified, the default integration will be used.

is_default.description: Indicates whether this is the default GitHub Enterprise integration

namespace.description: The GitHub organization / user the repository belongs to

block.description: GitLab VCS settings

One-way VCS integration using a raw Git repository link

block.description: Take the source from a Spacelift repo. The block takes no settings: `repository` is the repo's ID (slug), and `branch` must be `main` - Spacelift Repos have no branches, and the module always tracks the latest commit. The repo must be in the same space as the module, since the module publishes its source as a version.

spacelift_mounted_file.description: `spacelift_mounted_file` represents a file mounted in each Run's workspace that is part of a configuration of a context (`spacelift_context`), stack (`spacelift_stack`) or a module (`spacelift_module`). In principle, it's very similar to an environment variable (`spacelift_environment_variable`) except that the value is written to the filesystem rather than passed to the environment.

content.description: Content of the mounted file encoded using Base-64

content_wo.description: Content of the mounted file encoded using Base-64. The content is not stored in the state. Modify content_wo_version to trigger an update. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

content_wo_version.description: Used together with content_wo to trigger an update to the content. Increment this value when an update to content_wo is required. This field requires Terraform/OpenTofu 1.11+.

context_id.description: ID of the context on which the mounted file is defined

description.description: Free-form description of the mounted file

module_id.description: ID of the module on which the mounted file is defined

relative_path.description: Relative path to the mounted file, without the /mnt/workspace/ prefix

stack_id.description: ID of the stack on which the mounted file is defined

write_only.description: Indicates whether the content can be read back outside a Run. Defaults to `true`.

spacelift_named_webhook.description: `spacelift_named_webhook` represents a named webhook endpoint used for creating webhookswhich are referred to in Notification policies to route messages.

endpoint.description: endpoint to send the requests to

labels.description: labels for the webhook to use when referring in policies or filtering them

name.description: the name for the webhook which will also be used to generate the id

retry_on_failure.description: whether to retry the webhook in case of failure. Defaults to `false`.
